title: Lazar's holographic book at S4

tellings.quote: It was some kind of a holographic book that as you opened up the pages, whatever the stories were became a hologram.

plain: In the 1980s, at a secret site called S4 near Area 51 in Nevada, a man named Bob Lazar is said to have seen a book whose stories rose off the page as holograms when it was opened. A man named Robert Bigelow repeats what Lazar told him: "It was some kind of a holographic book that as you opened up the pages, whatever the stories were became a hologram." If true, it would be an object far beyond any human technology of that time.
